review.notes: Checked all 15 hat definitions twice against authoritative English source. Preserved boolean/hide flags, empty fields, slash layouts, numeric percentage form, and duplicated display-name fields exactly in structure. Names and descriptions received two editorial passes for concise idiomatic Greek, source humor and material details, correct agreement, and current Emily and Dwarvish glossary terminology.
